summary: Validated iter 84 P1 work: (a) 7-day Body Architecture chrono-lock + 48h Clarity Integration Lock backend; (b) Truth Sequence modal on landing hero. All 24 chrono_lock + sprint_b pytests pass. Added 7 live HTTP regression tests against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL — 7/7 passing. Playwright walks the full 5-step Truth Sequence flow end-to-end and lands on /portal.

design_issues.screen: Truth Sequence modal — step 1 hold gate
issues: Spec says the primary CTA wrapper should be `opacity-0 pointer-events-none` during the 4.2s hold. The wrapper currently sets pointer-events: none (correct, blocks clicks) BUT computed opacity is '1' on the immediate parent. Functionally the gate works (button is not clickable), but the visual reveal is not actually fading in — the button is visible the whole time, just unclickable. Minor — consider applying opacity-0 → opacity-100 transition class for full intended anti-dopamine effect.

action_items: (Optional polish) In TruthSequenceModal step wrapper, ensure the primary-CTA wrapper actually applies opacity-0 during the hold, not only pointer-events-none, so the reveal animation is visible.
critical_code_review_comments: services/chrono_lock.py is clean, well-isolated, no FastAPI imports — easy to unit test (good).
server.py is 16,816 lines — far over the 700-line guideline. Continues to be flagged in past iterations; chrono-lock additions are well-contained but the monolith is a maintenance risk.

POST /api/body-temple/complete correctly lazy-enrolls via ensure_body_enrollment AFTER the premium check — meaning a non-premium user attempting to complete will NOT trigger enrollment side effects. Good.
/api/grace/mode correctly returns 423 with detail.code='chrono_locked' when a different mode is selected, but accepts the same mode for integration continuation — matches the spec precisely.
